decisions.evidence: R1 maker presents 'Add and delete bookmarks' only. R1 client establishes the actual behaviour and corrects it: 'When I click "Add bookmark" it makes me type in the title and description myself... Right now it won't even save unless I hand-type a title... What I really want is to just paste a link and have the app pull in the page's name (and ideally a short description/icon) automatically'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Divergence established independently from the client's factual description of observed behaviour: mandatory manual title contradicts REF-BM-01 (save by entering a url) and the absence of auto-collection contradicts REF-BM-02. The client supplies the reference-conforming save behaviour, so corrective/correct. Single integrated save-flow correction covering both items.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker lists only 'Add and delete bookmarks' (no edit). R1 client: 'I can't fix a bookmark after saving it... there's no way to go back and edit a saved link — change its title, its tags, or move it. Part of managing my bookmarks is tidying them up after the fact.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Edit-existing-bookmark (REF-BM-04) is entirely absent from the presented scope; the client requests this related reference requirement, so corrective/extend. Divergence established by the absence being named against a reference requirement, not merely from a change request.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Add and delete bookmarks'. R1 client acknowledges 'I can add one and delete one'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Delete conforms to REF-BM-05; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Copy and open-link actions.' R3 client: 'I can save links... open... them'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Open-link navigating to the original url is functionally equivalent to REF-BM-08; conforming, not a divergence.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Search across titles, URLs, descriptions, and tags'. R1 client: 'I can see my saved links, search them'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Basic full-text search over title/url/description conforms to REF-BM-12. Advanced operators/#tag/phrase (REF-BM-14/15/16) were neither presented nor discussed, so no divergent decision is recorded for them.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: list/grid layouts, 'Polished empty states'. R1 client: 'clean, and I can see my saved links'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Readability-first list exposing title/description/tags conforms to REF-BM-07 (functionally equivalent display choice).

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'Pasting a URL now automatically fetches its page title, description, and favicon... Title is no longer required—the domain becomes a fallback'. R2 client: 'it pulls the page's real title and description automatically now... Both of those do the job for me — approved.'
decisions.note: Implementation review of the fix for decision 1. Now conforms to REF-BM-01/02 (auto-collect title/description/favicon; save by url without mandatory title). Preview-image portion of REF-BM-02 was not presented or raised; treated as substantially conforming. Recorded to link the earlier corrective to its disposition without re-counting the opportunity.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'Added an Edit action to each bookmark's overflow menu. Editing supports the URL, title, description, collection, and tags.' R2 client: 'there's a proper Edit option on each bookmark that lets me change the link, title, tags, and where it lives.'
decisions.note: Implementation review of the fix for decision 2. Conforms to REF-BM-04. Links the round-1 extend corrective to its resolution without double-counting the opportunity.
